title: OpenBrick3D fit profile
description: One printer, nozzle and material combination after calibration (profiles/fit/*.json, .obprofile.json). Read by openbrick-print as FitProfile with camelCase fields; see docs/plan/05 sections 3 and 4. Fit offsets live here, never in part documents. Schema 1.1 adds the optional calibration.pocketSet to 1.0; a 1.0 or 1.1 document may use only the fields named here ($defs/knownFields), and a 1.0 document none added since 1.0 ($defs/since1_1); material is free-form beyond its type.

process.description: Id of the process profile this calibration belongs to; batch export refuses a part whose process does not match.

material.description: Filament or resin; type is required, other fields (brand, colour, ...) are free-form.

intent.description: What the offsets aim at: genuine bricks or other prints from the same profile (open question Q05 in docs/plan/13).

since1_1.description: The fields added in schema 1.1 (calibration.pocketSet). A document that uses one declares 1.1 or later in its pragma (schemas/README.md, Versioning), so a tool that only has the 1.0 schema reads it leniently; a 1.0 document that uses one is an error at that field.

knownFields.description: The fields schema 1.1 names (those of 1.0 plus calibration.pocketSet), object by object; true means the value is checked by the main schema. Applied only to 1.0 and 1.1 documents (see atThisMinor), where any other field is an error: serde would drop it silently, so a misspelt optional field would change nothing. Objects not listed here are open on purpose. cargo xtask data checks that these lists match the properties the schema declares.

atThisMinor.description: Matches a document whose pragma names a minor version this schema knows, 1.0 or 1.1 (or a patch of either). Such a document may use only the fields this schema names ($defs/knownFields). A document of a later 1.x minor may carry fields added since; this schema checks the fields it knows and ignores the rest, so older tools can still read newer minors (docs/plan/08 section 9). Unlike the other shared definitions this one follows the schema's own minor version (cargo xtask data checks it against $id).

offsetMm.description: Offset in millimetres on a diameter (or depth for ribs) applied to nominal geometry at export: chosen coupon cell minus nominal. The coupon sweeps of docs/plan/05 section 4 reach at most 0.30 mm from nominal (horizontal Technic holes, 5.10 - 4.80), so a magnitude above 1 mm is a unit mistake.

firstLayerChamfer.description: Bottom-edge chamfer in millimetres against elephant's foot; not a diameter, so never negative.

xyScale.description: Uniform XY scale applied last; defaults to 1. Shrinkage compensation is a few percent at most, so anything outside 0.9 to 1.1 is a mistake.

calibration.description: The record the coupon wizard writes (openbrick_print::Calibration). Without it, or without the cell a fit-critical connector needs, rule FIT.MISSING blocks export.

couponVersion.description: Version of the coupon layout that was printed. Read as a u32 by openbrick-print, hence the maximum; 1 and 1.0 are the same number to both.

pocketSet.description: Since 1.1. The pocket set of the printed coupon (openbrick_part::coupon::PocketSet: cross, the default, is the nominal row and column of the tube OD x rib depth cross; crossAndDiagonal adds its diagonal; full is every pair). chosenCells.pocketTubeOD and chosenCells.pocketRib are the two values of one pocket of this set, the one that fits best, never the best of each line (one stud presses on the tube and the ribs at once; docs/plan/05 section 4). openbrick calibrate record writes it with the pocket cells and refuses a pocket the set does not print. Optional: 1.0 documents and documents without pocket cells leave it out.

chosenCells.description: Best-fitting coupon cell by row, in millimetres (diameters; pocketRib is a rib depth). Keys are the coupon rows of docs/plan/05 section 4 as required_cells() names them.

date.description: Calendar date of the calibration, YYYY-MM-DD.

pullTestN.description: Separation force of a printed part on genuine bricks in newtons (docs/plan/05 section 12); null until measured.

controlPullTestN.description: Genuine-on-genuine control pull on the same rig, in newtons; null until measured.

pragma.description: Schema version pragma: major 1 and a minor, optionally a patch (docs/plan/08 sections 1 and 9). Every 1.x is accepted: readers ignore fields from minors newer than they know, and this schema checks only the fields it names in documents newer than 1.0 (see atThisMinor).

spdx.description: An SPDX licence id, or a simple AND, OR or WITH expression of ids (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

credit.description: Who made the document. Keeping it is a community norm, not a legal condition (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

provenance.description: Where the data came from, so attribution travels with it through conversion, export and printing (LICENSE-POLICY.md, docs/plan/06 section 2).

source.description: original, or the upstream file or project the data derives from.

profileId.description: A profile id: lower-case words joined by hyphens, where a word may hold dots, as in fdm-0.4 or resin-msla (docs/plan/05 section 3).
